note: Gowers explains why he did not sign the 25 Fields medallists’ letter, doubting that conceptual understanding should be ranked above problem-solving and arguing that a flood of AI results need not make digestion impossible. His main worry is that the social structures that absorb and transmit mathematics, including PhD training and funding, may be lost; he also discloses contacts with OpenAI’s mathematics group, early access to some models and free access to its Pro models, and says he has never been paid by it.
title: Why I didn’t sign the Fields medallists’ letter
who: Timothy Gowers (University of Cambridge; Collège de France)
